description: This header file defines functions for prefetching memory into CPU cache levels, including prefetching, non-temporal prefetching, and prefetching for write operations, with platform-specific implementations and examples.

methods.name: PrefetchToLocalCache
methods.description: Prefetches memory into the cache with high temporal locality.

methods.name: PrefetchToLocalCacheForWrite
methods.description: Prefetches memory with intent to modify, potentially invalidating cache lines.
